Landed on main at 07960268 (code tip 6943a647, fast-forwarded onto main) (single-developer mode, self-reported gate, LocallyObserved).

Evidence: checkAll on a clean git-archive export of 6943a647: 4930 tests, 4927 passed, 0 failed, 0 errors, 0 ignored; 3 skipped by assume (the two worker/excerpt live courts, which have no venv or excerpt in a clean export, and one pre-existing pending test), 50 suite summaries, EXIT 0. BoundarySearchSuite 13/13 with the live ffmpeg + worker court run here. Mutation witnesses for this bead's guards, each killed by its named court with siblings green: instant from ordinal instead of index; recipe echo unchecked; coverage unchecked; cut range unchecked; worker identity dropped from receipt; auto kernel unresolved accepted; frame byte count unchecked; frames disposition unchecked; frames geometry unchecked; and after review pass 2: edit list assumed away; worker runtime unchecked; applied recipe unchecked; declared kernel override accepted. Recorded F0 outcome: cuts at ordinals 14 and 29 -> PTS 16000 and 32000 through the packet index; two worker runs byte-identical; the outcome's `applied` block is read from detector state and must satisfy the recipe.

Not established / follow-ups: the boundary axis is the picture stream's native clock admitted as the edition axis under a named, checked identity-edit-list assumption (reported stream start equals first presented PTS, no discards); no TrackComposition receipt exists and a non-identity edit list refuses. The worker's runtime is checked against the worker realization's version line, but the interpreter and wheel bytes are unhashed (script only); `applied` reads private attributes of the pinned scenedetect 0.7.1. Colour conversion is declared in the ffmpeg arguments (bt601, tv in, pc out) and the frame digests are unchanged by the declaration. Decoded frame k is bound to presented packet k by count x size only. F0's flat colours differ only in hue, so its recipe declares threshold 15.0 (F1 uses 27.0); thresholds are recipe parameters bound into receipts, not defaults.
